en.headline: Tung Chee-hwa state funeral set for North Point this weekend
en.dek: A vigil will be held on Saturday afternoon at the Hong Kong Funeral Home, with a public memorial and procession on Sunday morning, under an 87-member funeral committee.
body: Arrangements for a state-level funeral for Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong’s first chief executive, have been set for this weekend at Fuk Hoi Hall of the Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point. Tung died on the evening of 8 September aged 89. He also served as a vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference.

According to an obituary placed by the family and details published by the funeral committee, a vigil will run from 3pm to 10pm on Saturday, 19 September. A public memorial and funeral ceremony is scheduled at 9am on Sunday, 20 September, with a farewell at 11am followed by the funeral procession. The family asked that donations be made to charities of the giver’s choice in lieu of flowers.

The committee is chaired by Shi Taifeng, a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and first-ranking vice-chairman of the CPPCC National Committee. Deputy heads named in published notices include CPPCC vice-chairman Leung Chun-ying, Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office director Xia Baolong, and Chief Executive John Lee. The South China Morning Post reported the committee has 87 members drawn from political and business circles.

News outlets said the rites will follow the standard used for two earlier Hong Kong figures who held the same national rank, Ann Tse-kai in 2000 and Henry Fok Ying-tung in 2006, including draping the coffin with the national flag. Shi is expected to attend the Hong Kong ceremonies on behalf of the central authorities.

zh.headline: 董建華國葬周末在北角舉行 周六設靈周日公祭
zh.dek: 設靈周六下午在香港殮儀館福海堂，周日早上公祭及出殮；治喪委員會由全國政協第一副主席石泰峰擔任主任。
body: 香港首任行政長官、全國政協前副主席董建華的國葬級治喪安排已定於本周末在北角香港殮儀館福海堂舉行。董建華於9月8日晚病逝，享年89歲。
家屬訃告及治喪委員會公布，設靈定於9月19日（星期六）下午3時至晚上10時。公祭及殮葬禮定於9月20日（星期日）上午9時舉行，於上午11時進行告別儀式，隨即出殮。家屬表示懇辭花圈，如致送可轉捐慈善機構。
治喪委員會由中共中央政治局委員、全國政協第一副主席石泰峰擔任主任。已公布的副主任包括全國政協副主席梁振英、港澳辦主任夏寶龍及行政長官李家超。《南華早報》報道委員會共有87名成員，涵蓋政商界人士。
報道指儀式將按早前兩位同屬副國家級領導人的香港人士——2000年的安子介及2006年的霍英東——的規格進行，包括以國旗覆蓋靈柴。石泰峰預料代表中央出席在港的儀式。
